title: Manual Therapy
shortDesc: Hands-on joint and soft-tissue treatment to restore pain-free movement.
metaDescription: Hands-on manual therapy in Islamabad for neck pain, back pain and stiff joints. Joint mobilisation, soft-tissue release and Mulligan techniques at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: Manual therapy uses skilled, hands-on techniques — joint mobilisation, manipulation and soft-tissue release — to reduce pain and restore movement where a joint or muscle has become stiff, guarded or painful. Your therapist assesses how you move, identifies the segment that is actually restricted, and treats it directly. Hands-on work is paired with exercise so the range you gain in the session is one you keep.
whatWeDo: Full movement and joint assessment before any hands-on treatment
Joint mobilisation, Mulligan mobilisation-with-movement and HVLA where indicated
Soft-tissue release, trigger-point work and dry needling
A short home exercise plan to hold on to the range you gain

title: Sports Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Structured return-to-sport programmes built on objective testing.
metaDescription: Sports injury rehabilitation in Islamabad — ACL, hamstring, ankle and shoulder injuries. Criteria-based return-to-sport programmes at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: Getting back to sport is not about waiting for pain to settle — it is about rebuilding strength, control and confidence to the level your sport demands. We assess the injured limb against the other side, load it progressively, and only clear you to return when you meet objective criteria rather than a calendar date. That is what keeps re-injury rates down.
whatWeDo: Baseline strength and movement testing, compared side to side
Progressive loading through strength, power and plyometric phases
Sport-specific drills that rebuild change-of-direction confidence
Objective return-to-sport criteria before you are cleared to play

title: Orthopedic Physiotherapy
shortDesc: Recovery after fractures, joint replacements and orthopedic surgery.
metaDescription: Post-operative and orthopedic physiotherapy in Islamabad — knee replacement, fracture and post-surgical rehabilitation at The Muscular Junction, River Gardens.
fullDesc: After a fracture, a joint replacement or orthopedic surgery, the tissue heals on its own timeline — but range, strength and normal walking do not come back without work. We follow your surgeon's protocol, restore movement safely within it, and rebuild the strength around the joint so you return to normal daily activity rather than settling for a stiff, protected limb.
whatWeDo: Rehabilitation staged to your surgeon's post-operative protocol
Safe, early range-of-motion work to prevent lasting stiffness
Progressive strengthening around the operated joint
Gait retraining and walking-aid progression

title: Neurological Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Regaining movement, balance and independence after neurological injury.
metaDescription: Neurological rehabilitation in Islamabad for stroke, Parkinson's, Bell's palsy and nerve injury. Task-specific neuro physiotherapy at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: The nervous system retains a real capacity to reorganise after injury, but that change is driven by repetition of the specific task you want to recover. Our neurological rehabilitation is built around that principle: high-repetition, task-specific practice of walking, balance, reaching and hand function, progressed as you improve, with training for the family members supporting you at home.
whatWeDo: Task-specific, high-repetition retraining of walking, balance and hand function
Tone, spasticity and contracture management
Falls-risk assessment and balance training
Home programme and hands-on training for family caregivers

title: Pediatric Physiotherapy
shortDesc: Play-based therapy helping children reach their movement milestones.
metaDescription: Pediatric physiotherapy in Islamabad for developmental delay, cerebral palsy, torticollis and gait concerns. Child-friendly, play-based sessions at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: Children are not small adults, and children's rehabilitation does not work as a list of exercises. Sessions are built around play, so a child practising balance thinks they are playing a game. We work closely with parents, because most of the meaningful repetition happens at home between visits — you leave every session knowing exactly what to practise and why.
whatWeDo: Developmental screening against age-appropriate milestones
Play-based sessions that hold a child's attention
Positioning, handling and orthotic advice
Parent coaching so progress continues at home

title: Dry Needling & Cupping
seoTitle: Dry Needling & Cupping Therapy in Islamabad
shortDesc: Targeted techniques for stubborn muscle tightness and myofascial pain.
metaDescription: Dry needling and cupping therapy in Islamabad for trigger points, myofascial pain and muscle tightness — delivered by trained physiotherapists at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: When a muscle stays tight and tender despite hands-on treatment, trigger-point dry needling and myofascial cupping can reach tissue that manual work alone struggles to change. Both are used here as adjuncts, never as a standalone treatment — they open a window of reduced pain and better movement that we then use for loading and exercise, which is what makes the change last.
whatWeDo: Screening for contraindications before any needling
Trigger-point dry needling using single-use sterile needles
Static and moving (myofascial decompression) cupping
Immediate follow-up with movement and loading work

title: Cryotherapy & Cold Therapy
shortDesc: Controlled cold to settle acute pain and swelling early in recovery.
metaDescription: Cryotherapy and cold therapy in Islamabad for acute injury, swelling and post-operative pain — used as part of a wider rehabilitation plan at The Muscular Junction.
fullDesc: Controlled cold application is a simple, well-evidenced way to reduce pain and swelling in the early phase after an acute injury or operation. We use it to make the first days of rehabilitation tolerable — enough pain relief that you can start moving sooner. It is a supporting tool within a rehabilitation plan, not a treatment on its own, and we will always tell you when it has stopped being useful.
whatWeDo: Assessment of whether cold is appropriate for your stage of healing
Controlled, timed application with skin monitoring
Combined cold and compression for swelling management
Clear guidance on safe use at home
